title: Has anybody been in a fancy hotel with a giant color changing ceiling art installation?
content: This place has carpeted floors, a cinema, several restaurants, an old unrenovated section with oddly wide hallways and pale blueish green doors. other areas are dimly lit with beautiful bronze and golden accents on the railings and big staircases but also escalators that lead to grand lobbies with chandeliers but some places are blocked off with construction boards and it connects to other things too like what i think is an airport or train station. All the people who work in these places are earie, usually unhappy, grinning their teeth to be nice to you or they are just lethargic and mean. I find myself having to dodge interactions most of the time. Lingering in spaces too long tends to attract unwanted attention. Sometimes I find myself looking for something or accessing parts of this interconnected structure that i shouldn’t be in, much to the dismay of the people there. I could go on and on. There is another place like a coastal town close to a small university like city with several apartment buildings and street corners that i seem to visit frequently. There is even a little village with what seems like a bunch of white pod homes in a green field that are for very well of people. For some reason this city or town happens to love roundabouts and big open intersections outside of almost every building, almost like every building or street corners has a valet-like entrance area. I’ll make another thread about more of these dream spaces but i want to know if anyone has ever experienced something strikingly similar, particularly the iridescent color changing ceiling installation in a hotel-like area with maroon carpet flooring. The art thing seems to change color as you move towards or away from it, made of many small metallic panels, but it is so huge you could walk under it and not know where it ends and begins kind of.
